introduction: Navy SEALs: America's Secret Warriors is an in-depth, behind-the-curtain look at one of the most elite fighting forces in the world.S1 E1 America's Secret Warriors Part 1:An in-depth, behind-the-curtain look at one of the most elite fighting forces in the world explores the incredible history of the SEALs' predecessors in WWII and Korea through their evolution into elite warriors.S1 E2 America's Secret Warriors Part 2:Part 2 follows the evolution of the SEALs as they become the tip of America's spear in the War on Terror, executing high-profile missions including the raid on Osama bin Laden's compound in Pakistan.
